stories.headline: Dell Q1 AI server revenue jumps 757% to $16.1B; raises FY27 AI server forecast to $60B

key_facts.fact: Dell reported Q1 fiscal 2027 total revenue of $43.84B, up 88% YoY, beating the $35.43B analyst estimate
key_facts.excerpt: Total Revenue: $43.84 billion, up 88% year-over-year (beating Wall Street's estimate of $35.43 billion)

key_facts.fact: AI server revenue was $16.1B, up 757% YoY
key_facts.excerpt: AI Server Revenue: $16.1 billion, up an astonishing 757% year-over-year

key_facts.fact: Dell booked $14.4B in AI server orders during the quarter, leaving a $20B remaining backlog
key_facts.excerpt: The company reported $14.4 billion in AI server orders during the quarter, with a remaining backlog of $20 billion

key_facts.fact: Dell raised its FY 2027 AI server revenue forecast to $60B, up from a prior projection of $50B
key_facts.excerpt: FY 2027 AI Server Revenue Forecast: Raised to $60 billion (up from prior projection of $50 billion)

key_facts.fact: Dell shares jumped more than 38% in after-hours trading following the May 28 report
key_facts.excerpt: Dell reports Q1 revenue up 88% YoY to $43.84B... and forecasts FY 2027 revenue above estimates; DELL jumps 38%+ after hours

sources.title: AI server demand drives rampant revenue growth, Dell stock soars
Dell reports Q1 revenue up 88% YoY to $43.84B, forecasts FY 2027 revenue above estimates

stories.headline: Apollo and Blackstone arrange ~$36B debt deal to buy Google TPUs for Anthropic to lease

key_facts.fact: Apollo Global Management and Blackstone are arranging a roughly $36B debt financing deal to purchase Google TPUs
key_facts.excerpt: Total Amount: Approximately $36 billion in debt financing. Arrangers: Apollo Global Management and Blackstone... Purpose: To purchase Google TPUs (Tensor Processing Units)

key_facts.fact: The chips will be leased to Anthropic rather than sold directly
key_facts.excerpt: The chips will be leased to Anthropic rather than sold directly. This is structured as a debt financing arrangement

key_facts.fact: Apollo and Blackstone are working to bring additional investors into the deal
key_facts.excerpt: Apollo Global and Blackstone are working to bring additional investors into a ~$36B debt financing deal to purchase Google TPUs for Anthropic to lease

key_facts.excerpt: BYD announces the Xuanji A3 chip, which it calls China's most powerful chip for ADAS and the centerpiece of its new laptop-sized central computing platform

key_facts.excerpt: MediaTek says it has started working with Intel for advanced chip packaging in addition to its existing relationship with TSMC

key_facts.fact: The Taiwan-based mobile chip designer is betting on AI demand for growth as it diversifies its packaging supply
key_facts.excerpt: MediaTek says it has started to use Intel Foundry's advanced chip packaging in addition to TSMC's, as the mobile chip designer bets on AI demand for growth

stories.headline: EU drafts emergency powers to override chip supply contracts during shortages

key_facts.fact: The EU is preparing sweeping emergency powers to intervene in Europe's chip supply chains during shortages
key_facts.excerpt: The EU is preparing emergency powers to intervene in semiconductor supply chains during shortages

key_facts.fact: Under the draft law, chipmakers could be forced to override existing contracts and prioritize 'priority rated orders' during a declared crisis
key_facts.excerpt: The EU could force chipmakers to override existing contracts and prioritize certain orders. The Commission could compel companies to accept and prioritize 'priority rated orders' during a declared crisis

key_facts.fact: The measure is part of a Chips Act 2.0 reform driven by concerns over dependence on Asian chip manufacturing
key_facts.excerpt: Part of the Chips Act 2.0 (a follow-up to the original EU Chips Act)... Motivated by concerns over supply chain vulnerabilities and dependence on Asian chip manufacturing

sources.title: EU prepares emergency powers to intervene in Europe's chip supply chains

stories.headline: IBM to invest $10B+ in quantum, targeting first large-scale fault-tolerant computer by 2029

key_facts.fact: IBM plans to invest more than $10B in quantum computing over five years
key_facts.excerpt: Total Investment: More than $10 billion. Timeframe: Over five years

key_facts.fact: IBM aims to build the first large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer by 2029
key_facts.excerpt: Build the first large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computer by 2029

key_facts.fact: The target system, IBM Quantum Starling, is expected to perform 20,000 times more operations than today's quantum computers
key_facts.excerpt: System Name: IBM Quantum Starling... Expected to perform 20,000 times more operations than today's quantum computers

key_facts.fact: Starling will be housed in a new IBM Quantum Data Center in Poughkeepsie, New York, with investment largely focused on US-based manufacturing and research
key_facts.excerpt: Will be housed in a new IBM Quantum Data Center in Poughkeepsie, New York... The investment is largely focused on U.S.-based manufacturing and research

sources.title: IBM to Invest $10 Billion in Quantum Computing by 2029
IBM plans $10 billion investment, large-scale quantum computer by 2029
